method: Twelve serial fresh sessions, two repetitions per task/arm, two turns each. Same runtime and math@0.1.0; only docs corpus differs. All attempts retained. Source coding blinded to arm and transcripts.
limitations: Small descriptive comparison, no significance or causal benefit claim.
Costs are reported model generation costUsd, excluding preflight, specialists, and infrastructure.
Guide markers establish delivered text, not comprehension; scope paragraph is distinct from dedicated guide body.
Protocol gates short-circuit later numeric/pixel gates; failed cases have fewer emitted assertions.
Wall time includes template setup and must not be interpreted as model efficiency.
Clarification requests are separate from executable tool actions.
Repeated input/output index confusion coincided with unchanged contract wording; the wording is a plausible contributor, not an isolated experimental cause.
